description: Set the full per-day schedule for a Listing Bureau project. Replaces any existing schedule. Each entry represents one day with volumes for atc, sfb, and pgv. Max 365 entries. SFB is US-region only; ATC/PGV work in all regions (lower execution rate outside US).

atc.description: Add-to-cart volume (all regions; lower execution rate outside US)

pgv.description: Page view volume (all regions; lower execution rate outside US)

sfb.description: Search Find Buy (SFB) volume (US-region projects only)

name: lb_schedule_set
